newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil army to protect elections in violent state.
newsitem.headline: Brazil army to protect elections in violent state.

text.p: Troops will be deployed to a violent state in Brazil's poor northeast to ensure safety during local elections, an electoral court ruled on Friday.

Members of the Superior Electoral Tribunal voted unanimously to deploy army units to 100 municipalities in Alagoas state where 15 people have been reported killed in crimes linked to the Oct. 3 first round of municipal elections, the court said in a statement.

The most recent victims were two musicians shot dead when gunmen opened fire on a truck used as an electoral platform by a leading candidate for mayor of state capital Maceio on Wednesday, reports said.

The situation in Alagoas has been aggravated by recent strikes by police who have not been paid for months by the bankrupt state administration. Earlier this month, Alagoas police officers released 30 bank robbers and other prisoners from jails as part of their pay protest.
